data.description: The dread lord has dominion over even the dreams of its subjects. It can use dream and nightmare as spell-like abilities, each once per day, but targeting only creatures within its domain. Once per week it can attempt to gain control of a creature whose dreams it affects in this way. If the target fails a secondary Will saving throw (DC %1), the dread lord enslaves it, as per dominate monster, in addition to the dream or nightmare spell-like ability's normal effects.
